implementation: For blocks of2/4/8 original K16 groups, eligible product exponents are dominated by a normal entry carry. Product-only signed aligned sums use that fixed exponent; every interior carry must keep its original sign and binade. The last group retains original modulo sign disambiguation and canonical normalization. Rejected blocks reuse aligned sums only while the actual carry exponent still equals the entry exponent; otherwise unchanged staged replay executes. No combined sum is shifted to another exponent. Candidate selection, four-lane ownership and lossless36-byte prepared rows are unchanged. Audit instantiations expose every original three-word carry; normal instantiations do not write those traces.
correctness_scope: Independent original CPU K16 primitives check every carry and final raw output for seven generated shapes, each with three block widths; counts across variants include repeated input states. Every full-projection warmup and measured attempt compares all raw outputs to the current staged2 control and all BF16 outputs to the original GB10 operator reference. Every prepared operand word, original input, candidate ID and redzone is checked. QKV repeats1023 captured input/reference rows after its original7169 rows. OUT repeats1023 input rows; its separately captured GB10 reference already has8192 rows. References are comparison data only. These are components, with no new prompt or token loop.
timing_scope: One warmup plus three measured attempts per variant, with rotating variant order. Completed host timers include full weight/input encoding and replay in launches of at most262144 candidates. Common matrix producer and candidate selection, allocation, resets and validation are outside these component timers. Native process walls, build identities and host guards are attached. No startup, TTFT or decode throughput is measured.
decision: Keep isolated and do not integrate. All arithmetic, raw carries, GB10 projection boundaries, immutable inputs and guards pass. Every transfer width regresses on both full q8192 projections: current43.0396ms versus66.2627/73.8464/80.0056ms QKV, and159.292ms versus241.462/273.928/308.039ms OUT. Exact collapse does not repay its eligibility, staged state and fallback costs on this implementation.
